key.name: vendor
key.summary: Entry filter for the bar: '' tiles every configured account, a vendor slug (e.g. anthropic) shows all accounts of that vendor, an exact entry id (e.g. anthropic@work) shows that single account
key.description: Entry ids are the id fields printed by 'ai-usagebar-omarchy usage --json'. Empty is the default all-accounts view; the panel tabs and bar wheel switch entries without changing this key.

key.name: binary-path
key.summary: Absolute path to the ai-usagebar binary (empty = auto-detect on PATH / ~/.cargo/bin)

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Which panel area to live in (right = next to network/clock)

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position index within the chosen panel area

key.name: show-remaining
key.summary: Show what is left of each window in the bar tiles instead of the used percentage

key.name: bar-tiled
key.summary: Tile every working account side by side; when off, the bar collapses to the selected account alone

key.name: show-logos
key.summary: Lead each bar tile with its provider logo

key.name: last-selected-entry
key.summary: Entry id of the last selected account, restored across shell reloads (written by the extension, not by hand)

key.name: color-low
key.summary: Bar color for figures with at least 50% remaining

key.name: color-mid
key.summary: Bar color for figures with <50% remaining

key.name: color-high
key.summary: Bar color for figures with <20% remaining

key.name: color-critical
key.summary: Bar color for figures with <5% remaining

key.name: color-empty
key.summary: Color of the empty part of the bar

key.name: config-rev
key.summary: Bumped by preferences after every successful settings apply; the extension refreshes when it changes
